jobs.title: Vice President of Business Development
jobs.description: We're thrilled that you're here to explore the details of your next career step. Before proceeding with your application, we kindly request that you carefully review the requirements for this position. It is essential to ensure that you meet the necessary qualifications and are authorized to work in the country where this position is located. By fulfilling these criteria, you increase your chances of being shortlisted and joining itel at the earliest opportunity.   itel is seeking a dynamic and results-driven Vice President of Business Development to accelerate growth within the healthcare sector. This senior leadership role focuses on driving strategic new business opportunities, expanding market presence, and cultivating high-value relationships with decision-makers across insurance providers and hospital systems. The ideal candidate will have strong existing relationships within the healthcare industry and proven expertise in selling consulting services and staff augmentation solutions, with an ability to influence, negotiate, and close complex deals. ABOUT THE ROLE: As Vice President of Business Development, you will serve as a trusted advisor to healthcare clients, aligning itel’s solutions with their most pressing challenges. You will lead the charge in expanding our footprint, shaping client strategies, and ensuring long-term, sustainable growth. This role is highly visible within the organization and will directly contribute to itel’s vision of transforming healthcare through operational excellence and innovative partnerships. RESPONSIBILITIES: · Identify, prospect, and build relationships with senior stakeholders within healthcare organizations, including payers, insurers, and hospital executives. · Influence and help direct future product offerings. · Develop and execute strategic business development plans to drive revenue growth and achieve or exceed sales targets. · Position Itel as a trusted partner by delivering consultative, client-focused solutions that address critical business needs. · Lead and deliver persuasive executive-level presentations, proposals, and demonstrations tailored to healthcare decision-makers. · Negotiate and close high-value contracts for consulting and staff augmentation engagements. · Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless project delivery, client satisfaction, and long-term account success. · Monitor industry trends, regulatory shifts, and competitive landscapes to identify new opportunities and inform strategies. · Leverage CRM tools (Salesforce, Freshsales) to maintain pipeline visibility, forecast accurately, and manage client relationships effectively. QUALIFICATIONS: · Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Management, Business Administration, or a related field (master’s preferred). · Minimum 3–5 years of proven success in healthcare business development, with experience in consulting services and/or staff augmentation. · Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed revenue targets. · Deep knowledge of healthcare industry dynamics, including payer and provider ecosystems. · Exceptional leadership, communication, negotiation, and executive presence. · Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a strategic mindset. · Proficiency in CRM systems (Salesforce, Freshsales) and pipeline management best practices. · Ability to thrive independently and within a collaborative leadership environment. · Willingness and ability to travel as required. PLUS · Experience with healthcare technology solutions (core business systems, data analytics, AI). · Background in consultative selling environments with complex solution portfolios. This is a high-impact executive role for a business development leader who is motivated by growth, innovation, and transforming client outcomes in the healthcare sector.   itel is the largest Caribbean-born customer experience provider and we are now an award-winning international company. We take pride in empowering our teams, treating every member like family. itel is an equal opportunity employer offering competitive pay, as well as a whole host of benefits designed to support employee comfort, and wellbeing. This includes paid training, opportunities for career advancement & development, as well as medical and life insurance, in a fun and inspiring work environment with great on-site amenities. All you need is to be authorized to work in the U.S., in addition to having the necessary academic qualifications and experience for the position that best suits you.
